Question 11(b) [4 marks]: Distinguish between transformed and transforming resources for this business.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
A luxury clothing brand for made-to-measure men's suits has set performance objectives to increase customisation and quality.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
4 marks: Clearly demonstrates the differences between transformed and transforming resources for this business
3 marks: Demonstrates the differences between transformed and transforming resources for this business
2 marks: Sketches in general terms transformed and transforming resources
1 marks: Makes a relevant statement about operations

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
Transformed resources include materials, information and customers. Transformed resources are turned into outputs (in this case luxury suits) during the transformation process. In this case, materials are the fabrics and stitches, and information is the customer measurements and preferences that inform the final suit manufacture. Whereas transforming resources are the inputs of human resources and facilities that actually do the transformation. For example, the employees cutting and sewing the suit as well as the machinery, scissors and sewing that takes place to make the suit.

ANSWERS COULD INCLUDE (the student does not need every point):
Transformation processes, inputs: transformed (materials, information, customers); transforming (human resources and facilities).

TEACHER MARKER COMMENTS:
Students who did not use the correct terminology or mixed up transformed/transforming: 1 mark. No reference to the business in the scenario: 2 marks.
